## Summary
Describe the change and the user-facing reason for it.

## Change type
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] UI/accessibility
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Maintenance

## Verification
- [ ] `npm ci`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Manually checked loading, search, department filter, profile dialog, and responsive layout where relevant

## Privacy and accessibility
- [ ] No private employee data, credentials, or secrets added
- [ ] Keyboard and screen-reader behavior considered
- [ ] Images have appropriate alternative text behavior
- [ ] Documentation updated where needed

## Screenshots
Add before/after screenshots for visible UI changes, without real personal data.
